Involuntary manslaughter is the most serious crime he can be convicted of. He didn't intend to kill anyone, and the intended wound to the opposing player (a non-fatal battery) doesn't support murder. Shooting a gun in a crowd is not extreme recklessness here, and the killing wasn't in the course of a felony that supports felony-murder. So the death falls under involuntary manslaughter, meaning an unintended killing caused by criminal negligence or an unlawful act.
